desc: Deletes a Slackbot skill and its canvas, and removes it from every library, skill set, and the org catalog.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

skill_not_found.desc: The skill doesn't exist or the caller can't see it.

method_not_supported_for_skill_type.desc: Only canvas skills can be deleted.

restricted_action.desc: The caller isn't allowed to delete this skill.

feature_not_enabled.desc: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization.

canvas_deleting_disabled.desc: Deleting canvases is disabled for the caller's team.

internal_error.desc: The skill couldn't be deleted. Retry the request.
